source_name.description: Human-readable original document title or filename, kept as-is (not slugified).

generation_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Authored explicitly by the agent, never resolved implicitly at render time, so a delivered artifact is byte-reproducible from its JSON source.

output.description: Optional explicit output filename. If omitted, derived from source_name per the naming convention (lowercase, alphanumeric + underscores, .html).

markdown.description: Sanitized Markdown hierarchy: '#' title, '##' pillars, '###' entities/topics, '-' nested detail bullets. MECE, strictly source-based, no tables, no stray arrows/glyphs, no heading-level skips.

views.description: Optional guided tour: an ordered list of authored stops through the mind map, each centering on the nodes matched by 'focus'. Mirrors archify's views/focus concept, adapted to a hierarchy: 'focus' text must be grounded in 'markdown', never invented.

focus.description: Substrings to match against node text (case-insensitive) to find what this stop centers on. Must each appear in 'markdown' — the validator rejects a focus term that matches nothing.

note.description: Short caption shown while this stop is active.
